moments.title: Commonwealth Games Day 4 Kicks Off in Glasgow
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games continue today with Day 4 action, featuring the start of athletics and various finals, including swimming.

source.l: Commonwealth Games Official Site / ITV News

angles.name: General excitement
angles.copy: Day 4 of the Commonwealth Games is ON! Athletics begins today in Glasgow, plus plenty of medal action in the pool. What are you most looking forward to seeing?

angles.name: Welsh pride
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Team Wales! Two bronze medals already in the bag from the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow – with para-swimmer Rhys Darbey and the mixed freestyle relay team making us proud. Let's keep cheering them on!

moments.title: Fourth UK Heatwave Expected Midweek
moments.blurb: Parts of southern England are bracing for a fourth heatwave this week, with temperatures potentially reaching 32-33C by Wednesday, while parts of Wales have already declared a drought.

angles.name: Heatwave warning
angles.copy: Another heatwave is on the way for parts of the UK this week! Temperatures could hit 33C in the south by Wednesday. Stay cool and hydrated everyone.

angles.name: Welsh drought
angles.copy: Drought declared in parts of North Wales and the Upper Severn after a series of heatwaves and lack of rainfall. Please be mindful of water usage.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Top UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart (July 23-29) with 'Rein Me In'.

angles.name: Chart topper
angles.copy: New UK #1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is dominating the singles chart this week. Are you loving it?

angles.name: Chart legends still there
angles.copy: Still can't believe Oasis' 'Wonderwall' and The Killers' 'Mr Brightside' are in the Top 40! True anthems never die. What other classics are you surprised to see?
